## Work Experience

### Data Managment Analyst III

[*UF Health Integrated Data Repository*](https://idr.ufhealth.org) *(Feb 2023 - Current)*

- Designing and developing data science pipelines to improve the coverage and quality of data for **UF Health Research Enterprise**
- Curating data elements from EPIC **Clarity** and **Caboodle** and make them available for use in interdisciplinary research projects
- Developing Extract Transform Load (ETL) pipelines to deploy and validate data in Common Data Models like [OMOP](https://www.ohdsi.org/data-standardization/), [PCORNET](https://pcornet.org/data/common-data-model/) and [i2b2](https://i2b2.org)
- Maintaining databases for free-text sources like clinical notes, order and pathology reports, social determinants of health variables, genetic testing data, and additional health data sources
- Building patient-centric Digital Twin technology for UF Health Enterprise and implementing in [i2b2](https://i2b2.org) to improve cohort phenotyping
- Liasioning as an honest broker between researchers and UF Health/Shands data server to provision access to data based on IRB approved research protocols <!-- - Training research partners in [i2b2](https://i2b2.org) and [OHDSI ATLAS](https://github.com/OHDSI/Atlas/wiki) --> <!-- - Applying appropriate informatics methods to answer research questions -->
- Currently working on projects involving [UF Health](https://ufhealth.org), [UF Cancer Institute](https://cancer.ufl.edu), [UF Clinical and Translational Science Institute](https://www.ctsi.ufl.edu), [UF College of Medicine](https://med.ufl.edu), [UF College of Nursing](https://nursing.ufl.edu), [UF College of Dentistry](https://dental.ufl.edu), and [OneFlorida+ Clinical Research Consortium](https://onefl.net)
- Selected accomplishments
  - **10x**+ improvement in data delivery for free-text clinical notes and order reports
  - **5x**+ improvement in data delivery through OMOP Common Data Model
  - **5x**+ improvement for custom de-identification for data delivery
